minimum_manual_actions.action: Use the already-open seller tab to sign in or create the seller account and complete any identity/payout/onboarding fields required by Gumroad. Do not send credentials, ID images, tax numbers, payout data, cookies or OTP values to H03.

Authenticate at least one of Facebook, Pinterest, Reddit or YouTube in the existing growth browser profile. Facebook is preferred because Page/Group are both useful, but one authenticated channel is sufficient to resume a bounded canary.

optional_actions.action: Authenticate/setup only as backup if Gumroad onboarding cannot be completed promptly.

resume_condition: Primary seller state AUTHENTICATED/READY and at least one bounded growth channel authenticated after listing publication.
